issues.description: The commented example in the template Main class calls farm.feed(), but the problem statement and solution define the method as feedAllAnimals(). This name mismatch in the example code can confuse students about the correct API to implement and use.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the example in Main.java with the specification: replace farm.feed() with farm.feedAllAnimals(), or add a feed() method in Farm that delegates to feedAllAnimals() to preserve the example while keeping the specified API.

issues.description: The problem statement and the solution use the method name feedAllAnimals() to describe feeding all animals on the farm, but the template's example Main.java calls farm.feed(). This inconsistency in method naming for the same conceptual operation (feeding all animals) can confuse students: they may look for a feed() method (which does not exist in the intended API) or implement the wrong method name, making it harder to map the exercise description to the provided template and the expected solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template with the problem statement and solution by renaming the call in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java from farm.feed() to farm.feedAllAnimals(), or alternatively add a farm.feed() method in Farm that delegates to feedAllAnimals() so both names are accepted.
